messages:
anya (PM): Quick sync — I've sketched a PRD for a combined "fusion" API that does chat + embeddings + rerank in one call. Goal: single developer surface for QA-heavy search flows. Please skim acceptance criteria and list obvious edge cases.
kevin (SWE): Link? I'll skim after standup.
anya (PM): https://drive.redwood/fusion-prd (mock link) — TL;DR: 3 endpoints consolidated -> /api/v1/fusion.generate. Modes: 'chat', 'embed', 'rerank', plus a 'combo' mode that runs embed->candidate retrieval->rerank->chat-context.
jordan (ML Eng): Love minimizing round trips. Two immediate ML questions: (1) latency SLO per token in combo mode? (2) cache semantics for prefix tokens and embeddings?
anya (PM): Suggested SLO: p95 latency < 450ms for short (<512) tokens in combo mode on Dedicated. For Hosted best-effort p95 < 800ms. Acceptance criterion includes fallbacks to lighter model variant if SLO breach > 3% of requests per minute.
rachel (ProdOps): How do we detect/route to fallback? Need deterministic routing policy and observable metric. Put a metric like fusion.fallback_reason with tags {reason:model_load|latency|quota}. Also require rollout gating: canary at 5/25/50.
sophia (Design): From UX POV we need clear error shapes for partial failures — e.g., embeddings succeed but rerank times out. Small suggestion: include "partial_results" array in response and a top-level "status" enum {ok, partial, error}. Keep response compact for streaming.
kevin (SWE): Implementation notes: combo mode will likely run two model calls server-side. We'll expose an opt-out param `no_autocache=true` for troubleshooting. Example request (rough):
```json
{
  "mode":"combo",
  "query":"what's the best plan for refunds",
  "k":10,
  "rerank_model":"redwood-rerank-v2",
  "stream":true
}
```
Expected response skeleton (streamed):
```json
{
  "status":"partial",
  "candidates": [ {"id":"doc_123","score":0.82}, ... ],
  "chat": {"tokens": [...], "finish_reason":"length"}
}
```
kevin (SWE): We'll need SDK changes (client-side backfill) and migrations for telemetry.
jordan (ML Eng): Edge cases to call out in spec: empty retrieval set (k=0 or no docs), long context truncation interacting with rerank features, mismatch in tokenizer between embed and chat models, score normalization between model versions. Suggest acceptance test harness: synthetic bench that injects these edge cases and verifies deterministic outputs.
anya (PM): Good list. Add acceptance criteria: (1) integration smoke passes for Hosted & Dedicated, (2) fallback behavior exercised in canary, (3) telemetry present for prefix misses, cache hits, rerank latency percentiles, (4) SDKs updated and e2e sample app updated.
rachel (ProdOps): Rollout plan in PRD: feature-flagged, canary 5% for 24h -> 25% 48h -> 50% 72h -> remove flag. Auto-rollback if fusion.fallback_rate > 2% sustained over 15m or if error_rate spike > 0.5%. Deploy-bot: scheduled deploy jobs will post a message with canary markers and health checks.
deploy-bot: Note: canary deployment template created at infra/cicd/fusion-canary.yml. Use `deploy fusion --canary 5` to start.
sophia (Design): One more UX callout: when partial results returned, surface metadata why some docs omitted (e.g., stale retrieval TTL) to help customer debugging.
kevin (SWE): On logging: include deterministic request_id, model_versions, and a compact trace_id passed to Console for per-request traces. Also we should add unit test for race where cache invalidation happens mid-request.
jordan (ML Eng): For rerank model compatibility, add a graded scoring test across model versions (v1->v2) to detect ordering regressions beyond a threshold (Kendall tau < 0.8 triggers alert). Add it as a preflight check in rollout job.
anya (PM): OK — next steps: I'll update PRD with these acceptance gates and draft a short RFC for matching SDK surface changes. Please add specific test snippets to the doc (kevin/jordan). If no objections I'll mark PRD ready for review tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
kevin (SWE): ACK, will add test snippets.
jordan (ML Eng): Adding scoring regression tests now.
rachel (ProdOps): I'll draft the rollout playbook and alerting thresholds.
sophia (Design): I'll add the partial-results UX copy and sample error states.
anya (PM): Thanks team — ping me here if you land new sections so I can review iteratively.
